author: Ankit
problem: Read N, P, Q and N dish prices. A drink costs P yen, or Q yen (Q < P) with a coupon that also requires ordering one of the N dishes. Print the minimum total cost of getting the drink.
bug_description: The coupon total is computed as P - Q + dish instead of Q + dish.

comments.accurate: Takes the cheaper of the regular price and the coupon price plus the cheapest dish
comments.wrong_behavior: With the coupon, the bill is the cheapest dish plus the price difference P - Q
comments.wrong_location: Coupon total verified; check the final comparison when the coupon total equals P

source.buggy_line: b = min([p - q + a[i] for i in range(n)])
source.fixed_line: b = min([q + a[i] for i in range(n)])
